drafted_from: tools/close-a-list-row-when-i-say/records.json (tool:name-the-open-rows-a-message-names) and src/said-done.mjs saidDoneAsks; no live call was made
start_here: Say to your AI: "When I tell you a list row is already done, check it." The workflow reads the rows my message names, and this tool says which of them the question is about.
no_lists_because: It reads no list itself: the workflow passes in the open rows it read, and the tool only makes the questions for them, so no list of its own is kept.
instructions: 1. Give the message as { id, app, text, speaker } and the open rows it names, each with its list, its settling field and its values.
2. Give names.finish: the words of the list choice that says the AIs did it.
3. Set brought_in to true when the words are history brought in long after they were said; nothing is asked then.
4. Take each ask's question to the classifier and keep the ask, so the verdict step can use its values.

worked_examples.title: A named row gets its question
worked_examples.ask: I uploaded the plugin already, in the Claude Code app, about the row Upload the plugin.
worked_examples.given: The person says the plugin is done; the row Upload the plugin is named.
worked_examples.hands_back: One ask: its question says "I uploaded the plugin already" and names the row "Upload the plugin"; its settle values set status to "Done".
